full_text:
The extreme heat raises Ribera d'Ebre to orange alert with Terra Alta and Priorat off the official map.
The Meteocat activates a heat warning in Tarragona until Friday. La Ribera d'Ebre will rise to orange level, although Terra Alta and Priorat remain outside the yellow alert despite the high temperatures.
The Meteorological Service of Catalonia has activated a warning for intense heat in a large part of the demarcation of Tarragona from 2:00 PM this Thursday until 8:00 PM on Friday.
Most of the Tarragona regions will be on yellow alert during the episode, but the peak will be concentrated on Friday in Ribera d'Ebre, which will rise to orange level while Terra Alta and Priorat remain outside the general yellow warning.
Ribera d'Ebre will rise to orange on Friday
The most demanding phase of the episode will arrive on Friday.
The forecast places the highest heat values within the demarcation in Ribera d'Ebre, with a risk level higher than that of the other affected regions. In parallel, the yellow warning will remain in much of the province during both days.
The warning map excludes Terra Alta and Priorat from the yellow alert planned for this Thursday, even though the episode will affect a large part of the Tarragona territory. This regional distribution of risk has already had recent precedents in the official alert map and also in threshold changes applied by Meteocat in Meteocat's thresholds.
The warning requires extreme protection for vulnerable people
Recommendations focus on people most exposed to heat.
During the central hours of the day, the recommendation is to avoid direct sun exposure, maintain frequent hydration, and seek cool places. Precautions are also urged for vulnerable people in the face of an episode that will last until Friday afternoon.
The official warning period will end at 8:00 PM on Friday.
